advisory.purpose: Warn about regressions fixed on the release branch without redefining the normative target.
Canary for future language and API changes.

platformProfile.definition: Behavioral compatibility is required wherever GNU R behavior is meaningful inside a capability-safe browser runtime. Browser-inapplicable behavior must use an explicit adaptation or fail closed.

adaptations.behavior: Require an explicit host command adapter; otherwise fail closed.
Operate on evaluator-owned virtual storage unless an explicit byte transport is supplied.
Return a stable NativR session identifier, never a host operating-system process identifier.
Report the facilities actually available to the NativR session.
Use registered capability-safe handles and audited Wasm adapters; never expose host pointers or ambient dynamic loading.
Compare semantic graphics operations and documented output profiles without claiming platform-device pixel identity.

upgradePolicy: Changing the normative GNU R version requires an explicit compatibility-profile change, regenerated evidence, and release-gating review. A moving release alias must not redefine behavior.
